title: First half-hour predicts the last half-hour on index futures
hypothesis: When the first half-hour return of NIFTY or BANKNIFTY moves more than a threshold, a futures position in its direction from 15:00 to 15:29 earns a positive expectancy after charges.

mechanism.text: Late-day hedging and rebalancing by infrequent traders continues the morning's move.

evidence.source: Gao, Han, Li and Zhou, Journal of Financial Economics 129(2)
evidence.finding: First half-hour return predicts the last half-hour, about 6.7% a year.

evidence.source: Limkriangkrai, Chai and Zheng, Pacific-Basin Finance Journal 80
evidence.finding: Mainly in China and Japan, absent in Hong Kong and Singapore. India not studied.

turnover.basis: trading about 60% of sessions x 0.080% futures round trip, on notional; fewer at higher thresholds

needs: index futures minute bars 2022-2026 (or index minute bars plus the EOD basis)
available_now: Upstox v3 minute candles for indices and stocks from Jan 2022 (with a token)

prior_trials.basis: The intraday equity library (orb15-vwap 6, vwap-reclaim 9, gap-fade 4, pdh-breakout 9).

gates.span_exception: Minute bars start in Jan 2022 (Upstox); about 4.8 years. A pass is capped at WATCH until 10 years of forward and history exist.

holdout_rule.pass_if: Holdout expectancy after charges above zero over at least 60 trades and a positive predictive slope.

kill_criteria: Holdout expectancy at or below zero after charges.
The regression slope of the last on the first half-hour return not significant at 5% in validation.

prior.reason: No Indian evidence found, mixed in Asia; a 0.08% round trip a session dwarfs the US-sized effect.

feasibility.reason: Index minute bars exist from 2022; futures minute bars unverified; a short span.

contamination: The lab's 60 sessions of 5-minute stock bars (Aug-Oct 2026) were seen for other rules; no index intraday rule has been run.
